verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring work is a fair question for an AI file-storage product with an agent, but the evidence only shows one-off agent requests, such as multi-step tasks or organizing a folder. It also shows a scriptable CLI, which a user could drive from an external scheduler, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. No built-in recurring schedule, cron, or timed workflow is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
